I bought these chairs for setup with my outside tables when we do our seafood boils... they are really sturdy (info says they will support up to 880lbs (? - not sure about that, but they definitely held 300lbs) and easy to clean up with a wet rag, thus the appeal for my our use. You don't want to use a cloth seat at a crab boil!  They arrived fairly quickly (I have Prime) in pretty well reinforced boxes and in good condition. One thing to note: They come with protective plastic sleeves on the legs with the little plastic feet on the base of the legs over the top of the plastic sleeves.... so to remove the plastic sleeves without scratching the painted metal legs, you will need to get a phillips head screwdriver, remove the little feet allowing you to remove the plastic sleeves, and then replace the plastic feet. I purchased 12 of these chairs and it took about 1 1/2 hours to do this by myself.  Would have preferred NOT to do that, but the chairs are worth it in my opinion.

features: Set of 6: This folding chair will make a practical choice in the home or for hosting outdoor events. The textured seat ensures safe and comfortable seating.

description: Plan festive occasions centered around seating that is flexible for use in the home and commercial settings. Invite family and friends over without having to remind guests to bring their own chair. Plastic folding chairs are essential in any home for birthday parties, social gatherings, game night and Thanksgiving and Christmas dinners. When scheduling group seminars and team meetings, setup row seating effortlessly with the embedded ganging brackets on the sides of the chair frame. The clips provide uniform separation between chairs when setting up row seating. After an event you can place them on top of each other or in a row. Foldable chairs provide an on-demand seating solution from group therapy sessions to indoor and outdoor corporate events. These low-maintenance party event chairs wipe down easily after luncheons and store away with ease. Make a smart investment by purchasing multiple plastic folding chairs for your rental business, waiting room or corporate event.
